derivation.basis_digest: exact sealed candidate_source_basis digest, lower-case hex without prefix in URI
derivation.source_ref_digest: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 source_ref bytes, lower-case hex
derivation.contract_identity: exact AI 1.2 and NM 2.4 identities participate in context qualification but not locator derivation

identity_distinctions.canonical_source_identity: semantic identity from UUIDv7 or governed owner-local identity
identity_distinctions.source_instance_pointer: source locator retained only for integrity, diagnostics, provenance, and replay
identity_distinctions.detached_artifact_locator: opaque domain-separated normalized-model artifact locator, never a repository path
identity_distinctions.repository_path: not present in detached context and cannot be inferred

generated_values: Values required solely by Normalized Model 2.4 representation are deterministic ceremony only when uniquely derived from the fixed constants and sealed basis under this resource.
